description.value: La Quinta Inn by Wyndham Vancouver Airport is a five-story chain hotel in Richmond, BC, situated near Vancouver International Airport and the Alderbridge Way corridor. For touring cyclists arriving or departing by air, it offers a familiar mid-scale option in a commercially dense area with good road access. The hotel is part of the Wyndham Rewards program and operates under the La Quinta by Wyndham brand.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 53m; stands at 84m; rack at 88m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website content is almost entirely Wyndham's generic booking interface and navigation chrome — no hotel-specific amenity page (bike storage, laundry, tools, etc.) is visible in any of the captured subpages. OSM provides the core identifiers (address, phone, Wi-Fi tag) but per the rules, OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so Wi-Fi remains unconfirmed. The property is clearly a real, active hotel chain listing with no closure signals.
concerns: Fetched website pages contain only generic Wyndham booking interface — no property-specific amenity details were retrievable, leaving most fields unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational chain hotel with an active Wyndham booking page; no closure signals. Useful to touring cyclists near YVR.
